reviews.x: I’ve used a few different kinds of the plastic scrappers and this product is way superior to those. It doesn’t hurt my tongue or make it feel raw, but it still does a great job. Very happy with this purchase!
This tongue scraper is of great quality.  It doesn't bend easy and the shape of the handle makes the scraper easy to use.  The storage tin it a nice bonus too.
This is a great product. It definitely does what it is supposed to do. Haven't had bad breath since I've been using this everyday.

This feels good on my tongue. It doesn't hurt to use it and it's very firm and does a great job. it also seems to be very easy to clean which makes me more comfortable using it again. It comes with a set of 2 and I didn't need 2 but at least I know that if I accidentally leave it somewhere I still have one at home. I can't imagine that I'm going to need to replace them. I like the little metal box it came in as well. Not only is this good for my tongue and mouth health but it also is good for th
This silly looking tongue scraper looked like a spoon  does the job. Its actually better than the one with silicone i been using.

The last scraper I’ll ever buy! Easy to use and clean and unlike the plastic ones at the store, these don’t degrade or lose their shape. Packs easily, in its own slim case (the size of a nail file case).

Never thought about tongue scrapers until my last teeth cleaning when my dental hygienist, off handedly, asked if I ever brushed my tongue.  I ended up researching tongue scrapers and opted for these.  I am totally pleased with the product.  Now I use it once a day minimum. Makes my mouth feel extra clean and an easy addition to my daily oral hygiene care.
I have used other tongue scrappers.  This is the best.  Easy to clean and does very good cleaning tongue.  Plastic scrappers tend to make me gag.  I do not have that issue with this scrapper.

reviews.t: Too Flimsy to do any good.
reviews.x: They sell you two, but it would be better if you only received one, that was twice as thick. They bend too easily and the blade is much too narrow to be effective, requiring more than 2-3 passes to scrape your tongue surface. It may well be Medical Grade Stainless Steel, but it really doesn't make my grade !
It doesn't work as advertised.  I can do much better cleaning my tongue with a toothbrush when I am brushing my teeth.

The item works good.  It's fairly sturdy, although you can feel the bend in it if you apply pressure.  It's easy to clean and it's nice it comes with a case for traveling.  The only issue I had was it cut my tongue one morning.  I was probably in a hurry that day, but it hit my tongue straight on and it cut it.  Ever since then I've been more careful and slower.  Overall it works well, but I feel it's a bit sharp.

reviews.t: Hard and stainless metal that is durable and lasts for a long time without rust. Easily cleaned.
reviews.x: Hard and stainless metal that is durable and lasts for a long time without rust. Very quick and easily cleaned after each use. Comes in pack of 2, includes a very nice metal case for convenient traveling storage. The size of the scraper is just right for my liking. Customer service is great in reaching out to follow up with their product standing.

reviews.t: Great design but skimped on quality
reviews.x: Overall I like the product much better than plastic tongue scrapers I was using.  However, the thickness of the metal is just a hair to thin.  After 2 months of use the neck starts to bend and therefore requires you to bend the piece straight to use properly.
The scraping head tiny, isn't curved enough to do a good job and I can bend this with my hands. I was hoping for something more.
This did a poor job of cleaning my tongue and was slightly messy.
Although it works, it is no better than using a teaspoon.

This leaves a steel aftertaste in my mouth, but that I could live with if it did its job the way I would like. I have several tongue scrapers  because I wanted to try out different ones. This is the last one I would go to, if I even use it. I have not used it for several months now. It removes almost nothing from my tongue. The only upside would be that it will last for many years but is that really such an upside when it does not do what it is supposed to? It is not too heavy but if you are fly

I used to work as an orthodontist assistant and I have tried many tongue brushes back then. I love these better than any others I have tried!  I love the spoon shape on the end. It's perfect for scraping your tongue off. Also, the shape of the handle is comfortable to hold. Since they are stainless steel, I feel that they can actually be cleaned and be used for a LONG time. Most tongue brushes need replaced after a short time period. These will last forever.  It comes with 2 scrapers, a travel c

Very easy and comfortable to use - couple of scrapes per mornings and evenings, which takes all of 2 seconds each and I could see the things coming-off from my tongue, even after a thorough brushing. 3. it's kind of gross to think anyone would need to clean their tongue but I noticed some film one day while brushing. Ordered these. They came quickly. Used the spoon and although gross, it removed all of the film on my tongue. If used 3 times weekly it improves taste and taste bud function. It also helps with bad breath. Comes with 2 soaking tablets for sterilization, although soaking the spoon in rubbing alcohol or peroxide should do the trick just fine. Has a stainless Case to hold both spoons.

It’s okay, it technically does it’s job.. However my old plastic one worked 10x better and covered my entire tongue in one stroke verses the ten angles i have to maneuver to get the full tongue clean with this mini-spoon. The ONLY benefit is that i can throw it in the dishwasher... I went ahead and bought another plastic one and i only use this as a back up or for travel because of its case.

A great, healthful addition to the household, very helpful for cutting down oral bacteria. I love that they - yes, they - there are two included in the order - come with cleaning tablets and very clear instructions.  That there are two and a very handy, small travel case means you can take one with you on the go, or have one for you and one for another family member.  Most excellent!

reviews.t: Not perfect but way better than simply brushing
reviews.x: Works decently enough combined with brushing my tongue. Not perfect but way better than brushing alone, noticeable difference in cleanliness of my tongue, and I am prettier sure food tastes better.  Not perfect but good nonetheless. Comes with two apparatuses and cleansing tablets. Nice metal container for transport. Would recommend.

I purchased these Stainless Steele Tongue Scrapers as stocking stuffer and I'm so glad I did. They are very easy to clean, simple to use, and they loved them. I purchased one for myself too. They come in a nice container making it simple to travel with. They are reasonably priced can't say enough! Try them today .

I wasn't expecting much for such a cheap set, but these are really great. They're very basic (which I like) and super easy to clean. The pack of 2 means one for myself and one for my husband. I much prefer this style to the more common one that you see as well. Very happy with the purchase.

claims.text: Most reviewers find the scraper effective at cleaning the tongue and doing its job well.
Many reviewers praise it as easy to use and easy to clean.
Several reviewers highlight its durability and stainless steel construction, though a notable minority find it flimsy and prone to bending.
Reviewers frequently mention the included storage case as a nice bonus for travel.
A few reviewers report problems with the blade being too narrow, sharp, or ineffective, including one who returned it.
